We rejoiced with them as they chose to follow Jesus Christ and made sacred covenants to take upon themselves the Savior’s name, keep God’s commandments, and serve Him. By entering the waters of baptism, they literally followed not only the Savior’s example but also the examples of siblings, cousins, parents, and many trusted friends.

3.eng: My heart fills with gratitude when I think back on my own baptism. I was baptized at age eight in an impressive indoor public swimming pool. Back then, as we walked into the water, my mind and heart were preoccupied with this thought: “The pool is getting deeper and deeper, and I can’t swim!”

18.eng: The Book of Mormon tells us of two nations, the Nephites and the Lamanites, who were engaged in one of the longest-running sibling rivalries in the world. Wars and contentions literally defined their history for generations. But all of that changed when Jesus Christ appeared, taught them His gospel, and established His Church. For the next 200 years, the love of God replaced contention, and bitter enemies became “one”—they became “the children of Christ.” They became His covenant people.

18.spa: En el Libro de Mormón se nos habla de dos naciones, los nefitas y los lamanitas, que se enfrentaron en una de las rivalidades entre hermanos más prolongadas del mundo. Each week we gather as fellow disciples of Jesus Christ to renew our baptismal covenant and to remember all the covenants we’ve personally made with God. My dear brothers and sisters, the sacrament can become a fresh starting point for our personal relationship with God and for a greater Christ-centered unity in our lives.

26.spa: En esta senda hacia una mayor unidad, no pasemos por alto el poder unificador de la Santa Cena. Cada semana nos reunimos como condiscípulos de Jesucristo para renovar nuestro convenio bautismal y para recordar todos los convenios que hemos concertado personalmente con Dios. 27.eng: Have you ever noticed that the sacrament is the only ordinance we receive during which we are not addressed by name? Rather, it is performed for “the souls of all those who partake of it.” The only names that are used are those of God the Father and Jesus Christ. We partake individually but also as a group.
27.jpn: 聖餐せいさんが、わたしたちが受うける儀式ぎしきの中なかで、個人こじんの名前なまえが呼よばれることのない唯一ゆいいつの儀式ぎしきであると気きづいたことはありますか。むしろ、この儀式ぎしきは「〔聖餐せいさん〕をいただくすべての人々ひとびと」のために執とり行おこなわれます。 その中なかで唯一ゆいいつ用もちいられるのは、父ちちなる神かみとイエス・キリストの御名ぎょめいだけです。わたしたちは個人こじんとして聖餐せいさんを取とりますが、集団しゅうだんとしても聖餐せいさんにあずかっています。
